text: {"features":[{"name":"Role-specific fit articulation","description":"How precisely the letter connects the applicant's background to the actual problems, responsibilities, and priorities of this Information Security Engineering role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Frames the opportunity as a generic software or security job and makes little connection to the team's actual work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Names the role or team and expresses interest, but links past experience to the posting only in broad, generic terms."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Connects the application to some role themes such as secure defaults, vulnerability response, or security tooling, but only partially maps experience to the stated responsibilities."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Clearly aligns several past experiences to the job's responsibilities and shows a solid understanding of security automation, developer support, or lifecycle integration."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Precisely maps the applicant's background to the team's mission of scaling security through agentic tooling, vulnerability handling, and developer enablement, making the fit feel highly tailored."}]},{"name":"Software engineering track record","description":"How strongly the letter establishes mature production software experience through years of work, service ownership, and evidence of testing, maintenance, and launch.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows only a minimal production track record, with just enough information to clear the baseline and limited evidence of repeated ownership."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows some credible production experience, but the scope, years, or number of launched systems remain modest."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Presents solid mid-level experience across several production services and the full cycle of testing, maintaining, and launching."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows substantial experience well beyond minimum requirements, with repeated ownership of multiple production systems over several years."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Establishes a deep, seasoned track record through many years of production work, several launches, and clear evidence of sustained engineering ownership."}]},{"name":"Go depth","description":"How convincingly the letter demonstrates relevant experience using Go for the kinds of backend or infrastructure systems this role will build.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions Go only in passing or as one language in a list, without linking it to meaningful work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"States Go experience but gives little sense of frequency, ownership, or relevance to backend systems."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Makes Go a regular or primary part of the background, but without much detail on the systems built with it."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows meaningful ownership of Go backend or infrastructure systems similar to the kinds of systems this role requires."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows deep Go credibility by tying it directly to security, automation, or agentic backend systems under sustained ownership."}]},{"name":"Python depth","description":"How convincingly the letter demonstrates useful Python experience for tooling, services, automation, or agent work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention Python or gives no usable evidence of Python work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions Python only briefly or only as light scripting support."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows regular Python use for automation, analysis, or services, but without much depth signal."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes production-grade Python used for services, tooling, or agent layers with some quality or ownership signal."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows broad and dependable Python ownership across services, tooling, and AI or agent components, often with explicit testing, typing, or maintainability practices."}]},{"name":"AI application experience","description":"How well the letter shows hands-on experience building or operating AI-enabled features in production.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of AI or model-backed work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions AI only vaguely or as an interest area, without concrete hands-on experience."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States experience shipping AI or LLM-backed features, but gives little operational detail."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows production AI experience and mentions evaluation, reliability, or guardrail considerations."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows substantive production AI work with explicit attention to evaluation, failure modes, or trustworthiness in ways that strongly match this role."}]},{"name":"Agentic systems design","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates experience designing systems where software agents act autonomously within defined constraints.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of agentic or autonomous-system design."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Describes general automation, but not agents or bounded autonomous behavior."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Mentions agents or multi-step autonomous workflows, but without much architectural detail."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes agents with clear contracts, bounded actions, or backend guardrails that constrain what they can do."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents end-to-end ownership of agentic architecture with auditable boundaries, concrete backend-agent coordination, and clear relevance to the job's responsibilities."}]},{"name":"Vulnerability workflow automation","description":"How convincingly the letter shows experience automating vulnerability intake, triage, routing, deduplication, or related response workflows.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of work on vulnerability handling or security-response automation."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Expresses interest in reducing manual security toil, but gives no firsthand automation example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Mentions automating security handling or queues in general terms, but details are limited or fuzzy."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Gives a concrete example of automating vulnerability triage, deduplication, routing, or intake."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows strong ownership of a vulnerability-handling pipeline with concrete components or impact, such as classification, prioritization, routing, deduplication, or clear workload reduction."}]},{"name":"Security assessment experience","description":"How clearly the letter demonstrates hands-on practice assessing systems for security risk and following through on findings.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of actually performing security assessments."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows only a general security mindset or attacker awareness without direct assessment work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States security assessment experience, but keeps the claim high-level and method-light."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Cites concrete assessment work such as threat modeling, code review, attack-surface analysis, or validation of fixes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Depicts repeated, hands-on assessment work across services with clear methods, technical depth, and remediation follow-through."}]},{"name":"Algorithmic depth","description":"How convincingly the letter shows practical command of data structures and algorithms through applied engineering examples.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of data-structure or algorithmic skill beyond general software experience."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Claims strong algorithmic ability, but gives no concrete example of using it."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Includes one specific example of an optimization or redesign driven by data-structure or algorithm choice."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows a clear case where better structures or algorithms materially improved a real system's performance, tractability, or scalability."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents algorithmic thinking as a demonstrated strength through especially crisp, credible examples that feel central to the applicant's engineering value."}]},{"name":"Platform leverage mindset","description":"How strongly the letter shows motivation for foundational work whose benefits compound across many teams or systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows little or no interest in broad leverage, shared infrastructure, or organization-wide impact."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Expresses generic excitement about scale or Google's size, but not about foundational leverage specifically."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows interest in foundational systems, secure defaults, or work that helps others indirectly."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Consistently frames past and desired work in terms of organizational leverage, inherited improvements, or broad defensive impact."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes platform leverage central to the narrative, emphasizing the goal of multiplying scarce security capacity across the development lifecycle."}]},{"name":"Collaborative security orientation","description":"How well the letter positions the applicant to work constructively with security specialists and product engineers rather than treating security as isolated gatekeeping.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no signal of working with or enabling other engineers in security-related contexts."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Implies general helpfulness or seriousness, but does not show a clear collaborative security stance."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Mentions supporting developer teams or learning from security specialists in general terms."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Explicitly frames security work as enabling builders through usable defaults, tooling, or partnership."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Strongly emphasizes partnership with both security experts and developers, presenting security as a shared engineering practice rather than a policing function."}]},{"name":"Evidence specificity","description":"How much the letter supports its claims with concrete examples, scope, architecture detail, numbers, or outcomes rather than broad assertions.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mostly relies on adjectives and unsupported claims, with little concrete evidence for major qualifications."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Offers a few concrete details, but most claims still lack context, scope, or outcomes."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Includes at least one clear, specific example or some useful quantitative context."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Uses multiple concrete examples with clear scope, responsibility, technical detail, or outcome."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Consistently grounds major claims in precise examples, architecture choices, quantified context, or observable impact."}]},{"name":"Open-source stewardship","description":"How strongly the letter shows external engineering contribution through upstream fixes, maintenance, or project leadership.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention any open-source contribution or stewardship."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Hints at light involvement, but without clear evidence of meaningful contribution."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes occasional patches or limited contributions to open-source dependencies or tools."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows ongoing contribution or maintenance responsibility for an actively used project."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows sustained stewardship of a project with real users, including review, releases, roadmap ownership, or comparable community responsibility."}]},{"name":"Adversarial security practice","description":"How much the letter demonstrates hands-on security practice beyond normal software work through offensive exercises or external validation.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no sign of adversarial security practice outside regular engineering work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows only a light extra security signal, without meaningful evidence of hands-on practice."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows modest external practice such as Security+ or occasional capture-the-flag participation."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong hands-on practice such as OSCP-level work or consistently strong capture-the-flag performance."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows especially credible adversarial depth through demanding offensive credentials, standout competitive results, or both."}]},{"name":"Self-directed engineering initiative","description":"How strongly the letter shows self-motivated technical building outside assigned job scope.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Offers no self-directed technical work beyond the day job."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions small tinkering or a modest side project, but with little depth or challenge."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows a credible habit of building or maintaining useful personal tools or small projects."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes a substantial self-driven project with a clear engineering challenge or disciplined follow-through."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents an ambitious self-directed system, framework, or utility built to high standards, meaningful complexity, or real-world use."}]},{"name":"Writing mechanics","description":"How polished the letter is at the sentence level in spelling, proofreading, and error-free professional presentation.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Frequent typographical or spelling errors, including in salutations, role names, or key technical terms, materially damage professionalism."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Several visible errors recur throughout and noticeably distract from the content."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Occasional errors appear, but the letter remains easy to read and basically professional."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Writing is clean and polished with only very minor isolated slips."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Writing is fully polished, proofread, and free of noticeable mechanical errors."}]},{"name":"Narrative coherence","description":"How clearly the letter is organized into a persuasive, easy-to-follow argument for the applicant's fit.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Reads as disjointed or purely list-like, with weak flow between motivation, evidence, and conclusion."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Has a basic structure, but feels choppy, repetitive, or only loosely connected."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Follows a clear overall progression from interest to qualifications to close."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Organizes motivation, qualifications, and examples into a well-paced and persuasive case."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Delivers a cohesive, memorable narrative whose opening, progression, and closing reinforce one another."}]}]}
